purpose: Immutable generator and worker settings; final schedule and inference are in final_protocol.json
indel_model: Recursive homopolymer Poisson allocations with measured rates and explicit terminal states outside calibrated support
outside_measured_range: Stop further indel recursion for affected reads, retain and substitute them, save boundary labels and count affected reads; do not interpret unmeasured rates as biologically zero
primary_accuracy: exact centroid FN, FP and F1 against all designed barcodes, including zero-read truth
timing: Fresh worker wall time including Python worker startup, tool startup, required conversion and canonical centroid/member exports; excludes common input staging, scoring, hashing and downloads
cache_policy: Reuse verified outputs and timings only under their exact frozen signature. Never rerun a completed competitor cell automatically.
